description: This header file declares utility functions for extracting images and archive contents from archive files, as well as extracting archives to memory. It contains function prototypes related to archive extraction operations within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: ExtractImages
methods.description: Extracts multiple images from an archive file to a specified directory, with an option to keep the archive after extraction.

methods.name: ExtractImage
methods.description: Extracts a single image from an archive file to a specified directory, with an optional flag to keep the archive.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveContents
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of an archive file as a list of file paths without extracting.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveToMemory
methods.description: Extracts an archive to memory as a string, possibly extracting a specific member.

methods.name: ArchiveContents
methods.description: Returns a list of file paths contained in the archive.
